children.title: Cycle 50 · Path Dependence and Emergent Preferences in Multi-Agent Interaction Protocols

detail.title: Path Dependence and Emergent Preferences in Multi-Agent Interaction Protocols
detail.summary: This cycle continues investigating how early communication constraints and multi-agent interaction protocols shape long-term emergent preference formation, drawing on structural analyses of communicative multi-agent reinforcement learning (Comm-MADRL) systems.
